# Dragoon's Town v0.24

This update smooths the transition into large business expansion. Existing saves, earned prestige bonuses, holdings and imported production credits remain compatible.

- Introduce expansion income gradually from 751 through 1,000 locations instead of adding it all at the first purchase above 1,000. The highest-tier business's 1,000→1,001 income jump changes from about 54× to about 1.18×.
- Preserve production through the first 750 locations, including the earlier opening improvements. Existing owned businesses keep or gain income; this update does not cut their current production.
- Carry the gradual increase into the late expansion curve, preserving useful returns from larger purchases. Business prices, purchase quantities, milestone thresholds, the ten-million limit and prestige rules remain unchanged.
- Keep the existing save and backup formats. No progress reset or new save migration is required.

Financial/save regressions, full local/cloud verification, six browser layouts, eight touch cases and twelve 90-day strategy/schedule simulations passed. The focused transition checks cover 31,060 comparisons, protected saves, offline earnings, manager spending limits and prestige retention.

This is another targeted longevity balancing step. Middle-game objectives, remaining high-tier waiting walls, spending preferences and retained-income prestige incentives still need work; no fixed completion time is promised.

No real payments, advertisements, account service or paid servers were added. Android retains the original package and signing identity. Update through More → App updates → Check now without uninstalling.

Physical Thor/Android 13 installation and sustained performance remain separate playtests. Automated checks and instrumentation compilation are not physical-device results.
